records.name: ChickyTutor
records.tagline: A private language tutor that knows you better every day.
records.description: Hi Product Hunt! I’m Phanos, founder of ChickyTutor. We’re returning with an interactive whiteboard that brings visual teaching into spoken language practice. Ask about a language pattern, see examples, work through an exercise and discuss it with your tutor all during the conversation. We’ve also partnered with L’école de français to combine teacher-led French classes with daily AI practice between lessons at chickytutor.com/hybrid/french, and released ChickyTutor on Android.

records.name: offstage
records.tagline: Your computer-use agent gets a Mac account, not your screen
records.description: offstage gives Claude Code, Codex and opencode a second, logged-in macOS account to work in. Simulators, Xcode UI tests and the app your agent just built open on that account's desktop, so your screen, keyboard and mouse stay yours. Free and open source: https://github.com/viraatdas/offstage

records.name: OpenSEO
records.tagline: The open source Semrush alternative
records.description: Without good data, your agent gives generic advice. We provide the data, tools, and integrations your AI agent needs for SEO via MCP. Regular SEO is the foundation of good GEO, but we just released a new set of AI Visibility features as well.

records.name: Polylane for Vercel
records.tagline: An AI on-call engineer for your Vercel apps
records.description: Keep shipping while Polylane watches your Vercel apps. Connect through the Vercel Marketplace to bring projects, deployments, domains and logs into one live graph. Agents catch regressions, investigate the root cause with evidence, and open a pull request with the permanent fix for your review.

records.name: NOVA CLI v1.0
records.tagline: AI developer in your terminal
records.description: Nova CLI is an AI teammate in your terminal. Describe what you want in plain words and Nova reads your project, makes the change, runs your own tests and build, fixes what it broke, and gives you an honest verdict on what it checked. 160+ AI models are included on paid plans, with no separate AI account or API keys to manage. It works with the tests and tooling you already have, so there is nothing new to set up. Try Nova for free and see what it can do for your next task, here in your terminal.

records.name: Liquid Inference
records.tagline: LLM router where providers compete for every prompt
records.description: * Fully compatible with agentic coding tools: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Pi, Cline, and many more. Full multi-modal support. * Hundreds of open- and closed-weight models. Create routing rule presets or use our Auto routing algorithms. * Providers compete dynamically on price for every prompt, offering the lowest marginal cost. * Sign up for free with email, first 500 users get $20 of free inference. Receive 20% of referred fees as free inference, 10% for second-level referrals.

records.name: Paw-Paw
records.tagline: A tiny desktop pet for your Mac that types along with you
records.description: A small illustrated animal sits in the corner of your Mac's screen, reacts as you type and click, and naps when you pause. Choose which season earns XP and unlock dozens of Paw-Paws and 100+ items as you level up. Free and native; one optional $2.99 add-on.

records.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
records.tagline: Anthropic's fastest and most capable Haiku yet
records.description: Claude Haiku 5.5 is Anthropic's fastest and most capable small model, built for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks like summarization, classification, coding subagents, customer support, and browser use.

records.name: Ahem! Unmissable Meeting Reminders
records.tagline: Full screen reminders for ADHD, time-blind & focused brains
records.description: Most calendar apps assume you'll glance at them. Ahem! assumes you won't. On Mac and Windows, full-screen reminders interrupt deep focus, and one hotkey reveals your day. On iPhone, live countdowns, Lock Screen reminders and Dynamic Island nudges keep your next meeting in sight. Built for ADHD, time blindness and deep focus. Works with Google, Outlook and iCloud calendars. Available in 17 languages. Pay once per app, no subscription.

records.name: Simple Workout Log
records.tagline: The best minimalist workout tracker available
records.description: A clear record of your training, with room for what matters. Simple Workout Log is a minimalist workout journal designed to help you note what you did and find your starting point next time. Set up your account and training preferences on the web. Log strength and cardio workouts on mobile, follow your routines, and keep your training history in one place.

records.name: ProcBoss
records.tagline: Run, deploy, monitor, and manage your apps across servers
records.description: ProcBoss is a lightweight production process and infrastructure management platform for running, deploying, and monitoring applications across servers. Run Node.js, Bun, Deno, & other runtimes with clustering, automatic restarts, health checks, dependencies, cron jobs, logs, metrics, and GitHub auto-deployments. ProcBoss Cloud adds centralized server monitoring, deployment management, alerts, and hosted status pages; giving developers one place to keep production applications running reliably.

records.name: Revela
records.tagline: A film camera for iPhone that makes you wait for the lab
records.description: Revela is a film camera that lives in your phone. Pick a roll from a fridge of twelve original stocks, shoot it with no preview, then mail it to the lab and wait: an hour, overnight, or days. When the envelope arrives, pull the seal and see your photos for the first time. Prints develop from RAW with per-stock curves, grain and halation, and save to Photos at full resolution. Casual mode skips the wait. One price, no subscription, no account.

records.name: Chime
records.tagline: Private SMS categorization that never leaves your device
records.description: Chime automatically sorts your text messages into clean categories — OTPs, deliveries, promotions, banking, and personal — so you never dig through clutter again. Everything happens on-device, which means your messages stay private and never touch a server. No cloud, no accounts, no data harvesting. Just a quieter, organized inbox that works instantly and keeps your conversations yours. Set it up once and let Chime handle the noise.

records.name: Strac Comply
records.tagline: Get SOC 2 without the sales call
records.description: 1. Self-serve compliance automation. Sign up, connect AWS, Google Workspace, Okta, GitHub and Slack, and 100+ tests run continuously for SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS and more. 2. No per-framework fees 3. 14-day free trial, no credit card 4. Built by a data-security company, so it also finds the AI apps and agents in your workspace and maps them to the customer data they can reach 5. Run it from the dashboard or Claude Code via MCP 6. Platform $4,995/yr. Audit, vCISO and pen test tiers above

records.name: Drunken Penguins
records.tagline: Party card games on everyone's phone. No app.
records.description: Make a room, share a code, and everyone plays on their own phone. Secret votes, live results, no app and no sign-up to play. The Party Starter deck is free; extra packs are a one-time unlock. Plus Omi, the classic Sri Lankan card game.

records.name: Clippo
records.tagline: Orchestrate AI agent teams on a visual canvas
records.description: Stop drowning in terminal tabs. Clippo turns your software development into a visual command room on Windows. On an infinite canvas, connect agents like Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, CommandCode, Antigravity CLI, Kiro... simply by linking nodes to watch them code in parallel. Get on device memory to save tokens, native speed, and complete privacy with zero cloud or logins. Step up as tech lead of your own AI engineering team. Download Clippo now and take your workflow to the next level!

records.name: Markdoc
records.tagline: A shared Markdown editor for people and their agents
records.description: Write Markdown with the source and an editable preview side by side, live for everyone in the document. Review with comments and suggestions, bring your own agent over MCP, and publish straight to a gist or a repository file.

records.name: SineFrame M3
records.tagline: Test MCP servers and the agents that call them in pytest
records.description: Your MCP unit tests pass, but did the agent call the tool? M3 runs your server through real Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or Pi and asserts on the calls they actually made, in plain pytest. Direct tests need no API key. m3 ui shows every trace and tool call; m3 ci test --upload gates PRs and keeps runs on app.m3.sineframe.com. Open source, Apache-2.0.

records.name: tunnl.gg
records.tagline: Stable localhost URLs over SSH with no installs
records.description: Most tunnels hand you a new URL every time. tunnl.gg gives you the same one: connect as stable@proxy.tunnl.gg and your SSH key becomes your identity, so your public HTTPS URL never changes. Register a webhook or OAuth callback once and forget it. Nothing to install, no account, works on any machine with SSH, with a QR code and live request log in your terminal. Free to use. Pro adds your own subdomains, no time limits and a request inspector. Open-source (MIT) server.

records.name: Semwright
records.tagline: Give AI agents structured access to real software
records.description: Semwright is an open-source Rust runtime for AI agents working with desktop and professional software. Through structured drivers, agents can interact with application objects and project data, while a shared runtime handles permissions, execution, dependencies, artifact handoffs, and verification. It supports MCP without being limited to a single protocol, model, or agent. Build workflows across applications without rebuilding the same integration infrastructure for each one.

records.name: ClawCall
records.tagline: Your AI agent's phone to dial, hold, and reports back
records.description: ClawCall makes real phone calls for you, from the AI you already use. Ask ChatGPT, Claude or a Grok bot to cancel a gym membership, get quotes from repair shops, or sit on hold with your insurer. It dials, works the phone tree, waits on hold, talks to whoever answers, and brings back what was said. When a decision needs you, it rings you first and connects you if you say yes like a real assistant. Free for 30 calls, no card. Then $4.99/mo flat.

records.name: AgentGuard
records.tagline: Scan AI agent Skills for risks before you install them
records.description: AgentGuard scans AI agent SKILL.md files for security risks, hidden capabilities, and quality issues before you install them. Paste a Skill, get a Trust Report with scores, findings, and a clear verdict. Free to use — no account required.

records.name: OpenSwarm
records.tagline: A swarm of agents, in the same place you work
records.description: Stop bolting AI onto your computer. OpenSwarm is an AI-first operating system where agents run the whole machine: apps create themselves, browsers control themselves, and swarms of agents work together. Your OS just became an infinite canvas, and your work just transformed from you doing one task at a time, to orchestrating dozens in parallel. Tell it what you want and a swarm of agents does the work with you at the helm.

records.name: Off the Record
records.tagline: Block AI from transcribing your meetings.
records.description: Off the Record reshapes your voice in real time so people can understand you while AI notetakers and hidden interview copilots struggle to transcribe it.

records.name: Claude for Google Workspace
records.tagline: Bring Claude directly into Google Docs, Sheets & Slides
records.description: Claude now works directly inside Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides. Ask it to draft and edit documents, analyze spreadsheets, write formulas, build charts, or create presentation slides — all without leaving your file. You can also create and edit Google Workspace files directly from Claude using the new connectors. No more copying and pasting between apps. Available in beta for all paid Claude plans.

records.name: Termaxa
records.tagline: See what an AI agent's command would destroy before it runs
records.description: A gate in the hook path of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Copilot. It shows what a command would delete, backs it up first, and asks or refuses by your policy. Start in observe mode: nothing blocked, a report of what it would have caught. Open source, Rust.

records.name: Isle Notch
records.tagline: Lowweight minimal dynamic island for Windows
records.description: Isle sits at the top of your screen. Closed, it's a small pill with a little face. It looks around, waves when you sign in, and hides in a game or a video. Hover or click and it opens. Music. Volume for each app. Clipboard. A timer, pomodoro, and today's calendar. Notes. Drop a file or a shortcut on it and open it later. Wi-Fi, brightness, night light. Battery, and a speed check. Stick it to the top or let it float. Change the color. If the face is too much, turn it off and keep the clock.

records.name: Mailwell
records.tagline: Native Mac mail for IMAP, JMAP and Microsoft 365
records.description: Mailwell is a native Mac mail app for people with more than one account. Gmail, iCloud, Fastmail, Kagi Mail, Microsoft 365 and any IMAP or JMAP server share one unified inbox. Mail is stored on your Mac and syncs straight to your provider: no Mailwell servers, no tracking, no ads. Inbox tabs, rules, snooze, send later, and undo for everything. AI is optional and off by default. Turn on MCP and Claude can search your mail, read only.

records.name: judged.systems
records.tagline: The judgment API platform for support systems.
records.description: Support systems call judged.systems when a ticket needs a judgment. The helpdesk stays the system of record. You send the ticket. A pack defines the questions: queue, urgency, refund request, policy risk. Back comes a choice and its probabilities, a score on a rubric, or the probability a statement is true. Your thresholds return accept or review. A failed call stays in review. The ticket is redacted first. The evaluation is stored as it happened. A label on a miss leaves it untouched.

records.name: Side
records.tagline: A little AI chat panel that lives beside your Mac's Dock
records.description: Side is a tiny AI chat panel that sits right beside your Mac's Dock: one glance away, never in the way. • Fits the gap next to your Dock, floats above other windows, works across Spaces and full-screen apps • Switch providers, models and reasoning levels in one conversation • Bring your own account: sign in with ChatGPT or use an API key • Compact composer that expands to full height when needed • ⌘⇧Space to show or hide Free and open source (MIT).

records.name: Hallmonitor
records.tagline: See and answer every coding agent from your notch
records.description: See every Claude Code and Codex session on your Mac and your servers, live: in the notch, menu bar, a native app and the terminal. Know who's done, who's stuck, and answer their questions right from the notch. Free and open source

records.name: Hark
records.tagline: The personal AI that handles life before you have to
records.description: Hark Pro is a personal AI designed to take things off your plate, not add another chatbot to your day. It remembers what matters, thinks ahead about what you might need, and uses its own cloud computer to get things done across the web — from managing calendars and email to shopping, travel, bills, and everyday errands. Your sensitive credentials stay encrypted, Hark never sells your data or shares it with advertisers, and you can watch it work.

records.name: Cekura Bench
records.tagline: Speech-to-speech model benchmarks on live phone calls
records.description: Cekura Bench publishes voice AI benchmarks you can verify. Our new speech-to-speech benchmark tests 9 realtime voice models, including GPT Realtime 2.1, Gemini Live, Grok and Phonic, as complete phone agents on live calls: 82 scenarios, three runs each. Models are ranked on reliability, data accuracy, stalled calls, response time and cost, and every call transcript is public. Cekura Bench also covers voice agent benchmarks and STT benchmarks, with TTS benchmarks coming soon.

records.name: tide
records.tagline: A Jitsi alternative that does a few things really well
records.description: tide is a simple, self‑hostable video conference service, alternative to Jitsi. It let's you host your own "meet.custom.domain" for a simple video conferencing environment with all core features you expect, including: link sharing, screen sharing, recording (server-side). A few things, done well.

records.name: KloudMate 2.0
records.tagline: AI-powered Full-Stack Observability & Agentic SRE-Ops
records.description: 3 years after launching as an AWS serverless monitoring tool, KloudMate returns to PH as a full-stack, AI-powered Observability & Agentic SRE-Ops platform. It unifies metrics, logs, traces, and more, while KloudMate AI helps teams investigate incidents, find root causes, and resolve tickets. From dashboards to instant answers, KloudMate is built for modern, distributed systems. KloudMate AI Modules - Assistant (Answers), Builder (Dashboards, Alarms), Investigator (RCA), Docs (Documentation).

records.name: pmtui
records.tagline: Autopilot for long-running AI sessions in terminal
records.description: pmtui focuses on managing multiple agents and solving long-horizon tasks. Autopilot does what an agent loop does, except loops drift once the work runs long. So pmtui keeps the loop outside the agent and rebuilds the prompt each time from your goal and the agent's own last status. You choose how often to check back, and it only surfaces what really needs your attention

records.name: aegis
records.tagline: Smart personal safety app connected to 24/7 dispatch
records.description: Aegis replaces friction-heavy panic buttons with an intelligent personal safety shield. When triggered, it links directly to 24/7 emergency dispatch while sharing a live context payload (real-time GPS, reason for alert, streaming audio/video, and vital health data) so responders never arrive blind. Built for everyday safety, it features Athena AI anomaly detection, fall detection, adaptive accessibility, and trusted contact networks.

records.name: Typeling
records.tagline: Translate in your iPhone keyboard. Keep your tone.
records.description: Stay in the conversation, even when the language changes. Typeling translates in your iPhone keyboard with tones for friends, partners, and business. Preview your translation, then tap to replace your text. Translate into six languages, or paste an incoming message to read it in yours. Start with 50 free translations; top up with in-app credits when needed.

records.name: Udon
records.tagline: Control deck for your Mac home server with AI sysadmin.
records.description: Udon brings self-hosted apps, containers, storage, and monitoring together on your Mac mini or any Apple Silicon Mac. Manage it all from your browser, mobile companion or tell the built-in AI assistant what you need.

records.name: BotBus
records.tagline: Manage your local coding agents from your phone
records.description: BotBus connects local coding agents to your phone. Manage Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, OpenCode, DeepSeek Harness and more across computers. Continue supported tasks, handle approvals, view files and PDFs, and use a terminal. macOS adds screen control and shared web previews. Hosts: macOS, Linux, Windows. Mobile: iPhone, Apple Watch, Android APK. Your computer stays online; capabilities vary by connector.

records.name: Moonwalkers Dusk
records.tagline: Strap-on motorized wheels that let you walk twice as fast
records.description: Discover Moonwalkers Dusk electric shoes by Shift Robotics. Our lightest robotic shoes yet, with three sizes, three finishes, and speeds up to 7 mph.

records.name: Leanback
records.tagline: Personal AI assistant for managing engineering teams
records.description: Leanback is your personal AI assistant for managing engineering teams. It checks in with your team, reads every ticket and calendar, and delivers a clear action plan inside Slack, before your first coffee.

records.name: Epilude Narrator
records.tagline: Listen to any article, doc or text on your Mac
records.description: Narrator reads selected text, documents, web pages, and images aloud on your Mac. Choose an on-device or cloud voice and follow every word.

records.name: Simo
records.tagline: The judgment layer for software that acts
records.description: Simo is the System 1.5 judgment model from Temprl Labs. Ask typed questions about text, screenshots, or video and get calibrated probabilities and the values needed to act, in milliseconds.

records.name: Tonefold
records.tagline: Describe a song, get every part as editable MIDI
records.description: Tonefold is a free, open-source AI music composer for macOS and Windows. Describe a song to Claude, get chords, melody, bass and drums in a piano roll you can edit note by note, then export MIDI, WAV and stems.

records.name: Tractionwave
records.tagline: AI attention heatmaps for ads to check before you spend
records.description: TractionWave evaluates ads and marketing visuals with AI attention prediction — a heatmap and ranked hotspots in seconds. Know it gets seen before the budget goes live.

records.name: WibesHR HRMS, Payroll Vendor Management
records.tagline: HR, Payroll & Employee Management Made Simple
records.description: Manage attendance, payroll, hiring, and vendors, all from one place, so your team can work smarter from anywhere.

records.name: Keep Booked
records.tagline: Turn missed calls into bookings for UK small businesses
records.description: When a UK barber, plumber or garage can't answer the phone, Keep Booked texts the caller within seconds with their booking link, so the job isn't lost to the next place. The booking page shows only real free times, reminders cut no-shows, Google review requests go out after each visit, and quotes and invoices are sent from a phone and chased automatically. Keep your own number or take a new one. From £39 a month, texts included, no contract, 30-day money-back.

records.name: PREACH+
records.tagline: Your all-in-one sermon workspace: study, prep, preach
records.description: PREACH+ is a sermon-preparation workspace for pastors and preachers: deep Bible study, word studies and maps, AI-assisted prep, and a clean Preach Mode for the pulpit. Bilingual English/Spanish from day one. Free to start.

records.name: Code-Cube.io Automated Marketing Data QA
records.tagline: Stop losing revenue to broken tracking
records.description: Stop burning ad spend on broken tracking. Code-Cube.io is the automated data QA platform that protects your revenue, pixel integrity, and conversion data. Features like Tag Monitor, DataLayer Guard, and AI Network Inspector continuously audit user journeys to catch tag misfires, silent tracking bugs, and broken scripts in real time. Scale your ad campaigns with 100% data accuracy—replace manual QA with instant alerts and single-click root cause fixes. Trust your data. Maximize your ROAS.

records.name: JSON to SQL Converter
records.tagline: Instantly convert JSON to SQL. No AI, zero uploads.
records.description: A strict, 100% client-side utility that converts JSON arrays into CREATE TABLE and INSERT INTO statements. Instant, private, and runs entirely in your browser.

records.name: Hexowatch OR:ON
records.tagline: Tell it what to watch. It tells you what changed.
records.description: OR:ON watches public web pages and tells you when the part you care about changes, and what it changed to. Paste a link and say what matters in plain words: "tell me when the price drops." Alerts read like "Pro plan price changed from $49 to $39," with before and after side by side. Ask OR:ON, or connect Claude or ChatGPT, about your change history. Built on 5+ years of Hexowatch, with a 10x higher success rate opening pages. Free plan, no card.

records.name: AestheticBios
records.tagline: Aesthetic bios for Instagram, TikTok & Discord in one click
records.description: Free aesthetic bio maker. Pick a style, add your name and interests, and copy a ready-made Instagram, TikTok or Linktree bio in one click. No sign-up.

records.name: Harmony Lab
records.tagline: Build, hear, and export your next chord progression
records.description: Move from a harmonic idea to a progression you can hear. Start with a scale, functional harmony, a custom sequence or generated suggestions. Adjust chords, voicings, instruments and playback patterns, then export MIDI or audio for songwriting and production. Harmony Lab helps songwriters, arrangers and curious musicians explore how chords work together. Available on web, iOS and Android, with a free plan and optional paid upgrades.

records.name: OneStar
records.tagline: See why users love or leave any app or game
records.description: OneStar reads App Store, Google Play and Steam reviews and shows what users love, why they leave and what they ask for, with the reviews behind every number. Research a market: report on any app or game free, or compare up to four on Pro. Listen to your own users: connect App Store Connect to read every review, see what changed after a release and which bad reviews still need a reply. Built on Jev, which asks every review the same questions.

records.name: Gizmory
records.tagline: Your gadgets, memories, and life in one timeline
records.description: From your first phone to your everyday gear, Gizmory keeps the devices you have used and the memories behind them in one personal timeline. Find models in the device catalog, record when you used them, add stories and photos, and turn your history into shareable cards. Available on iOS and Android, with free features and optional Pro upgrades.

records.name: InvoiceFlow Starter Kit
records.tagline: React/Expo frontend for B2B invoice tools
records.description: A production-ready React + Expo frontend for building B2B invoice tools. Ships with invoice upload (image + PDF), AI extraction flow, a three-check verification UI (amount / date / duplicate), a line items data grid, and CSV export. Unlike generic templates, this kit includes real B2B workflows: Supabase RLS setup, PDF-to-image pipeline, multi-step verification states, and a ledger UI. What you need to add: your own Supabase project and your own AI model API key. Setup takes about 15 minutes.

records.name: YOMIOO
records.tagline: AI image & video studio—create from a prompt or photo
records.description: YOMIOO is an AI creative workspace for images and videos—not just another single-model generator. What’s different: • One place for text-to-image, photo-to-art, and short AI video • Ready-made workflows for real use cases: pet portraits, anime clips, fantasy creatures, and more • Access the latest image & video models without jumping between apps • Prompt or upload a photo → get results you can actually ship Built for makers who want speed and quality in one studio, not five tabs.

records.name: Ledgestra
records.tagline: One platform for your books, cash & everything they touch
records.description: Ledgestra is an Accounting & Treasury Saas application specialises in general ledger and financial reporting, payables and receivables, bank statements and cash position, inventory, procurement, and sales built as one connected system instead of exports stitched together in spreadsheets.

records.name: Executive AI Assistant Setup
records.tagline: Turn ChatGPT or Claude into your AI chief of staff
records.description: A step-by-step playbook that turns your AI assistant into a chief of staff. It walks you through writing custom instructions, building a "context vault" so your AI knows your priorities and people, and installing 10 core workflows — morning briefs, email triage, meeting prep and debriefs, decision memos, weekly reviews, and more. Total setup is about two hours, then roughly ten minutes a week of maintenance. Tool-agnostic and works on free tiers.

records.name: Equofi — Family Finance, Simplified
records.tagline: The family finance app that never owns your data.
records.description: Equofi: family finance, private by design. • Your data lives in your own Google Drive, not our servers • On-device Private AI, so nothing leaves your phone • Scan receipts into itemised transactions • Family budgets and spend tracking • Split bills with friends and family • Add expenses by voice • Sync Gmail, Outlook or IMAP • Share receipts into Equofi from any app • Advanced spending analytics • Manage multiple families in one app

records.name: Fil 3arda
records.tagline: Live scores, lineups, tables and cup brackets
records.description: Fil 3arda is your app for following football as it happens. • Live scores for every match and competition: the Egyptian League, the UEFA and CAF Champions Leagues, Europe's top leagues and the World Cup. • Match events by the minute: goals, cards and substitutions. • Lineups on the pitch, with a rating for every player. • League tables and groups, updated with every match. • Knockout brackets for the cups, all the way to the final. • A statistics centre, top scorers and the FIFA ranking.

records.name: OpenVGal
records.tagline: Opensource 3D galleries with ease
records.description: Open source, you can self-host, you can test without registration

records.name: Brainrot Gaming
records.tagline: Free brainrot browser games with controls and play guides
records.description: Brainrot Gaming is an independent directory of free brainrot browser games. Browse quizzes, escape games, clickers and puzzles with controls, device notes and practical guides. Third-party games run through official embeds; no site account is needed. Checked desktop picks and availability notes help visitors choose a game. Support varies by game.

records.name: BillboardFC
records.tagline: Bid on billboards in a virtual football stadium
records.description: Put your brand in a virtual football stadium. Choose a billboard in 3D or on the stadium map, bid for free, and pay if you win. Campaigns run for 5 full days. Mini board opening bids start at $3. One title sponsor gets sitewide visibility.

records.name: Level Up Daily: Hero Idle RPG
records.tagline: Grow stronger every day in a fast-paced idle hero RPG
records.description: Level Up Daily is an Android idle RPG from Rainbow Rabbit Games. Progress through auto battles, challenge bosses, collect heroes and costumes, upgrade equipment, craft abilities, explore dungeons, and compete in rankings. Google Play pre-registration is now open, and the linked page includes a full gameplay trailer.

records.name: PrideBank
records.tagline: See the money. Plan the next move.
records.description: PrideBank is a financial command center for independent businesses, entrepreneurs, freelancers, and team. Manage expenses, income, invoices, tax estimates, payments, and financial plans in one workspace. Track where money comes from, where it goes, and what needs attention. PrideBank turns scattered financial information into a calmer, clearer view of your business, helping you plan ahead, understand your position, and make smarter decisions with confidence. Your money. Your plan. Your business.

records.name: MonitorDefend.Com
records.tagline: bulk website managment & security tool
records.description: MonitorDefend: Your website's bodyguard. Stop losing revenue to silent failures. MonitorDefend watches your websites and funnels 24/7. It catches broken links and lost backlinks, downtime, indexing problems, and hidden Search Console opportunities. It also checks your payment flow, hosting storage, and unexpected URL changes. Get alerted before visitors, rankings, or sales suffer. One dashboard, zero blind spots. Built for marketers, agencies, and funnel owners.

records.name: Vorak Freelance
records.tagline: Connect freelancers with real clients, fast and simple
records.description: Vorak Freelancers is a platform connecting freelancers with clients quickly and transparently. Whether you're a designer, developer, writer, or marketer looking for work — or a business that needs one — Vorak makes it simple to find the right match without the noise of bigger platforms. Built with a focus on the Armenian market first, with plans to grow internationally. No heavy fees, no complicated onboarding — just real connections between people who need work done and people who can do it.

records.name: VITA by Tregunta Lines
records.tagline: Own your life story, past, present, and future
records.description: VITA is a personal operating system that helps you organise, understand, and forecast your entire life. A sovereign, private, beautifully designed platform that puts your data, your decisions, and your future fully under your control.

records.name: Jaspers Terminal
records.tagline: An open-source, free harness for public markets.
records.description: Jaspers Terminal is the agentic terminal for public markets: an open-source desktop workspace for professional investors, quants, and traders.

records.name: Meeting Noter
records.tagline: On-device meeting notes for Slack, Teams, Meet and Telegram

records.tagline: Free profit calculator for sellers and small businesses
records.description: ProfitPal helps small businesses, online sellers, freelancers, resellers, and entrepreneurs calculate profit, profit margin, markup, ROI, break-even price, and target selling prices while factoring in business expenses. It supports multiple currencies and works without requiring an account.

records.name: RentaBuddy
records.tagline: Meet trusted local companions for real-world experiences
records.description: RentaBuddy is India’s platform to discover verified local companions, guides and activity partners. Find people nearby for city tours, events, cafés, travel, gaming and social experiences across Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, Noida and 10+ cities. Browse profiles, explore services and connect through a simple, location-based platform designed for safe, strictly platonic experiences.

records.name: Orbital
records.tagline: A software factory for everyone.
records.description: Turn goals into finished work with coding agents on autopilot.

records.name: StreetJams
records.tagline: Find and share free curbside treasures near you
records.description: StreetJams is a community map for stooping: finding and sharing free items left on the curb. Spot a chair, post it in seconds, or browse what's nearby. Available now on iOS and Android. Give good stuff a second life, for free.

records.name: Frensense
records.tagline: Security analysis that actually understands your code.
records.description: Frensense traces data flow across your application to catch critical vulnerabilities before they reach production. Deep semantic analysis with zero configuration. No cloud AI just knowledge corpus with support for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust

records.name: Automation ROI Calculator
records.tagline: Calculate the ROI of Automating Any Workflow
records.description: Estimate whether a workflow is worth automating before you build it. Enter task volume, time spent, labor cost, automation cost, and expected efficiency gains to calculate annual savings, hours saved, payback period, and ROI. Includes conservative ramp assumptions and a stakeholder-ready PDF report. Free to use in your browser.

records.name: Synthvora Growth
records.tagline: 163 free online tools: PDF, converters, calculators & more
records.description: 163 free online tools: PDF tools, converters, calculators, SEO tools and developer tools. No signup needed.

records.name: Vuenia
records.tagline: Podcasts, videos and courses produced by AI, directed by you
records.description: Most AI content tools turn one prompt into a black-box result. Vuenia gives you a team of agents (researcher, scriptwriter, narrator, slide designer, video editor, publisher) in a pipeline you can see and steer. Step in anywhere: approve the outline, rewrite a line, swap a voice. Verification agents check facts and dates before you review. Bring your own API keys at no markup, see the cost of every step, schedule runs, and publish podcasts and videos straight to YouTube.

records.name: PodSafe
records.tagline: Enjoy podcasts with your kids, without the profanity
records.description: PodSafe makes it safer to enjoy podcasts with your kids. It automatically detects and filters profanity as you listen, without sending audio or transcripts to the cloud. Everything happens privately on your device. Browse and follow podcasts, import your Apple Podcasts library, and listen in the car with CarPlay. Built for parents who want to share great podcasts with their children without worrying about the occasional F-bomb.

records.name: Optimitor
records.tagline: AI SEO and GEO agency: found on Google, named by AI
records.description: Optimitor is a senior-led SEO and AI visibility agency. We get companies found on Google and named by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and AI Overviews.

records.name: Random Focus
records.tagline: Break screen time with real-world photo challenges
records.description: Random Focus turns screen-time control into a game. Every 30 minutes to 10 hours (your choice), find and photograph a real object—or take a daily selfie—before the timer ends. On-device AI checks each shot. Complete the challenge to earn coins and keep streaks; miss it and your selected distracting apps are blocked. Set sleep hours and keep a private Presence Diary. Free to download with in-app purchases. Native for iPhone and iPad, iOS 17+.

records.name: Scan Via Cam
records.tagline: Scan a document with the iPhone camera and share the image.
records.description: Scan Via Cam turns paper into a clear image on iPhone—receipts, notes, invoices, whiteboards, business cards, or certificates. Capture is cropped and enhanced, then shared as PNG by email or another app, or printed with AirPrint. Files stay on the phone and are not uploaded to the developer's server. No signup and no payment card. It is a personal scanner, not a shared archive.

records.name: Realatic
records.tagline: The Revenue Engine for Indian Real Estate Agencies
records.description: Realatic is an end-to-end CRM platform designed exclusively for small and mid-sized real estate agencies in India. records.description: Cooking at home takes a lot of planning and mental energy: finding that recipe you cooked 3 months ago, deciding what you both want to eat this week, handwriting the grocery list. Brioche puts it all in one shared cookbook, meal plan and grocery list.

records.description: Pick a cast of real-inspired, historical, fictional and unhinged characters, then hang out in a group chat. They talk to you and to each other. Ask something serious and they get serious. Ask about pineapple on pizza and they riff.

records.name: ScopeGate
records.tagline: AI writes your scope, flags work clients didn’t pay for
records.description: ScopeGate helps freelancers and small agencies stop losing money to scope creep. Describe your project in plain language and AI writes a clear scope of work — flagging vague language like “unlimited revisions” before it causes disputes. When a client asks for something new mid-project, log it and AI flags whether If not, generate a priced Change Order in seconds and send a link for the client to approve before you do the extra work for free. Free to use during beta — no credit card required.
